title: Visibility gates for error-budget reprioritization and on-call playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight ‘visibility gate’ system and associated playbook that ties SLI/SLO burn signals into product/ops prioritization. When service-level indicators cross configured thresholds we should: 1) surface a clear prioritized action card in the initiative backlog, 2) open a scoped incident/retrospective placeholder, and 3) apply a temporary release/feature-hold tag until triage completes. Goal: reduce noisy escalations while ensuring teams act within defined error-budget rails and product managers can re-prioritize roadmap items dynamically.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard view that shows active gates (green/amber/red) for top 10 customer-facing services
Automated creation of a prioritized action card in Linear when budget crosses amber (30% remaining) and red (10% remaining) thresholds
Playbook doc linked on each action card with clear triage steps, ownership, and rollback guidance
Feature-release hold annotation that can be toggled by SRE/PM and recorded in the release changelog
Manual override and noise-suppression mechanism (snooze for 6h / add contextual suppressor) with audit trail
